name: payments_api
description: Payments API spec vs design doc. Paraphrases (900 seconds = 15 minutes), a table, conflicts, an exact identifier (PF-1042), a TLS distractor for an at-rest encryption requirement, and a prompt-injection line.

requirements.text: The system must authenticate clients using the OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow.
The system must expire access tokens after 15 minutes.
The system must expire refresh tokens after 30 days.
The system must lock out a client for 10 minutes after 5 consecutive failed authentication attempts.
The system must support idempotency keys on POST /payments so retried requests do not create duplicate charges.
The system must store payment amounts as integer minor units, never as floating point numbers.
requirements.evidence: decimal number in the major currency unit

requirements.text: The system must allow merchants to refund a payment up to 180 days after it was captured.
The system must respond to POST /payments within 300 ms at the 95th percentile.
The system must handle card data in compliance with PCI DSS v4.0.
The system must encrypt all data at rest with AES-256.
requirements.note: TLS sentence is about data in transit — a distractor

requirements.text: The system must retry webhook deliveries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
requirements.evidence: retried up to 3 times at 1 minute intervals

requirements.text: The system must include a machine-readable error code such as PF-1042 in every error response.
